test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

My mother said, “You must __pay attention to__ your studies.”
solution:
The correct answer is **"Concentrate on"** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the given sentence is **"****pay attention to__****"**.
 
• You watch, listen to, or take notice of someone if you **pay attention to** them.
 
• The first option is **"****Concentrate on"** which indicates to give something your whole attention means concentrating on your thoughts or your attention on it.
 
• Therefore **"Concentrate on"** is more relatable to **"__pay attention to__"** than others.

The correct sentence is **My mother said, “You must __c____oncentrate on__ your studies”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• To **"back up"** someone is to express your agreement with them in front of others. Basically **"back up"** means to support.
 
• The meaning of **"Act up to"** is to be equal in any action. This phrase is not related to the given question.
 
• **"Ask for"** indicates a desire to speak with someone. 
 
• The above three phrases are not appropriate according to the question.
